{{Quote|It's the perfect plan. Evacuate everyone off-planet. They all go willingly. Then move in&hellip;"<br />"Four Padawans are going to foil an invasion from an entire planet?|[[Tru Veld/Legends|Tru Veld]] and [[Darra Thel-Tanis]], on Avon's intended invasion of Radnor|<ref name="Way of the Apprentice" />}}
'''Radnor''' was a small, [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a small main landmass, and prevailing winds. It was located in the same [[Star system/Legends|system]] as [[Avon]]. Radnor had two [[Capital/Legends|capitals]]: the [[Twin Cities (Radnor)|Twin Cities]] of [[Aubendo]] and [[Tacto]]. Each of the cities had their own governing [[minister]]s. Radnor was known for its research and development of high-tech weapons systems.

==History==
During the [[Galactic War]], a noted [[Sentientologist|anthropologist]] discovered a remote commune of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]] primitives on Radnor.<ref name="Primal">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Primal Force}}</ref>

When Radnor was struck by a [[bioplague]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], the inhabitants of Avon, the [[Avoni]] (through the machinations of [[Dol Heep]]), tried to conquer the world. The plague, caused by a bio-weapon toxin released by [[Galen (Radnoran)|Galen]], first struck the city-state of Aubendo. The city-state of Aubendo was called the [[Isolation Sector]] because no one could exit [[Aubendo]] once they entered. Tacto was called the [[Clear Sector]] because there weren't any plague cases there. The ministers of Tacto fled, creating a panic among the healthy [[Radnoran]] populace, followed by widespread looting and unrest. An eight-member [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] team that included [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], were [[Mission to Radnor|sent]] ahead of [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]-provided evacuation [[Transport/Legends|transports]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to attempt to bring calm and relief to the populace.

[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Organa (Star Destroyer)|Bail Organa]], in his persuasive pleas that lucidly communicated the dire position of "a planet overcome by a toxic disaster," was directly responsible for the quick action of the Senate to provide immediate relief vessels for the world's survivors. This was, of course, a surprise to all, as, ever "mired in bureaucracy, the Senate sometimes took months to debate a simple issue."<ref name="Way of the Apprentice" />
